title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop consisting of four curves. The first line starts at coordinates (0.0, 0.4397) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0283). The third line starts at (0.75, 0.0283) and ends at (0.0483, 0.4397). The fourth line starts at (0.0483, 0.4397) and ends at (0.0, 0.4397). Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles set to zero and translate it using a translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0244 units in the direction of the normal, creating a new solid body. The final shape is a cylindrical object with a pointed tip at one end and a flat, rounded end at the other. The body is smooth and uniform in diameter, with a length of 0.75, a width of 0.4397, and a height of 0.0244.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.4397) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0283) \
     .lineTo(0.0483, 0.4397) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.4397) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0244)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq
import math

# The part is a long flat rectangular bar lying in the XY plane,
# rotated diagonally in the top view (running from upper-left to lower-right).

# Cross-section dimensions
w = 0.0244   # bar width (in-plane, Y direction before rotation)
t = 0.0244   # bar thickness (Z)

# Rotation angle of the bar in the XY plane (top view diagonal)
theta = 29.55  # degrees, going down toward +X

# Solve bar length so the bounding box matches X=0.75, Y=0.4397
c = math.cos(math.radians(theta))
s = math.sin(math.radians(theta))
L = (0.75 - w * s) / c

# Build the bar centered at origin, then rotate about Z and translate
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(L, w, t)
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -theta)
    .translate((0.4, 0.25, t / 2.0))
)
